title: Terminal Machine architecture
summary: Terminal Machine is terminal-neutral automation infrastructure. Transport, protocol, presentation model, detached semantic snapshots, known-state memory, control authority, service hosting and emulator recovery are separable layers. IBM 3270/TN3270 and TN5250 are sibling personalities rather than definitions of the generic core.
invariants: Generic Terminal Machine code must not acquire protocol-specific assumptions merely for convenience.
One live terminal mutation owner may coexist with many detached read-only observers.
Terminal Machine owns terminal/session/screen/field truth; MVS Alchemy owns guest semantic truth; Hercules Services owns emulator/control-plane truth.
ConnectSelector and Socket Provider are optional integration boundaries, not hidden dependencies of the native 3270 datastream engine.
Detached snapshots/actions/evidence remain value objects unless lifecycle identity is actually required.
procedure: Trace a 3270 path as TCP -> Telnet/TN3270 or TN3270E -> 3270 data stream -> presentation space -> detached snapshot -> known-state/ownership/control.
Trace a 5250 path as TCP/TLS -> Telnet -> TN5250/RFC1205 -> 5250 workstation data stream -> field model -> known-state/ownership/control.
Keep protocol-specific transport adaptation outside the semantic presentation model.

provenance.claim: Supports the current Terminal Machine architecture and 3270 P0 continuity.
